newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr closes slightly stronger in quiet day.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr closes slightly stronger in quiet day.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed slightly firmer at C$1.3417 (US$0.7454) from Monday's close ofC$1.3430 (US$0.7446) in quiet trading, dealers said. * Tuesday's strength is likely only a temporary reprieve in an ongoing correction, dealers said. * The currency was able to firm as corporate buyers showed no interest Tuesday.
"This is the long overdue retracement of the big move we've had in the last couple of months," Wateridge said.
But the underlying tone of the currency is strong, he added.
Once the currency weakens to about C$1.3480, buyers of the Canadian dollar will step in and give the currency a boost stronger, he said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1212 marks from 1.1175 marks on Monday and went up to 83.13 yen from Monday's close of 82.99 yen.
